text:
Aurelia Skyways records the complaint that a companion animal was not secured to the expected standard during the journey and that the reported lapse caused distress and delay in the follow-up process.

We have reviewed the file with urgency and confirm that the welfare coordinator checked the animal comfort notes while the cabin team reported the in-flight condition of the carrier and the surrounding area. The report now sits with our incident register for final handling, and the passenger service record has been linked to the same case file so that no further delay arises from misplaced papers.

For escape in transit, a claim must be filed within 59 days after the incident is entered. For escape in transit, the standard payout is $438 when the claim is approved under the governing terms.

Please send the remaining supporting record at once if it has not yet been provided, including the travel reference, the carrier note, and the written account of what was observed after landing. Once the file is complete, we will move it to determination without avoidable pause. If the complaint concerns service handling rather than the incident outcome, that point is also being logged for review by the responsible desk.

Records Aide Companion Animal Travel Desk
